findings.question: q-earth-science-astronomy-weather-and-climate-0022
findings.quote: A tropical cyclone occurs outside the usual peak season. Which conclusion follows from Philippine cyclone climatology?
findings.problem: The stem gives away the conclusion by stating that a cyclone occurs outside the peak season. A student can select “Cyclones can occur outside the July-to-October peak” by repeating that premise, without knowing Philippine cyclone seasons or climatology.
findings.fix: Ask which statement correctly describes the seasonal occurrence of Philippine tropical cyclones, without first stating that an off-peak cyclone occurs.
